authority.primary_statistical_source: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission / Kenya Gazette, 21 June 2022, Gazette Notice No. 7290

statistical_treatment.rule: For each of the 290 canonical constituencies, use the exact sum of all official IEBC First Schedule child ward registered-voter rows. This includes the ten Mandera East/Lafey ward rows withheld from spatial attribution; their statistics remain valid for constituency totals.
statistical_treatment.direct_schedule_note: The Gazette also contains a Second Schedule of constituency totals, but the governed first promotion must preserve the already-audited Sprint 2 B/Official-derived treatment unless a separate direct-schedule ingestion is independently validated.
anti_inheritance: Never inherit a county registered-voter value into a constituency.
Never omit the ten Mandera East/Lafey source rows from constituency totals because their hold concerns geometry, not statistical validity.
Never force-match the ten held ward rows to uncertain current ward polygons.
Do not alter the 20,115-slot governed denominator.

promotion_gate: Exactly 290 existing unresolved P23 constituency slots for IND-REGISTERED-VOTERS must exist before promotion.
All 290 promoted constituency rows must reconcile to canonical constituency geography codes.
The values must be generated deterministically from the audited IEBC ward-row source pipeline rather than copied from county totals.
Source, reference date, official-derived treatment and boundary-hold semantics must remain attached to the promoted series/observations.
Completeness may move only after the native seed/build pipeline emits the 290 canonical observations and the full deterministic rebuild reconciles.
Atlas validation, P16 release audit and the P23 registered-voter validator must be green before merge of any numeric promotion.
next_atomic_tranche: Implement the native deterministic builder that writes the 290 constituency series/observations through the canonical indicator registry, then rebuild and resolve exactly those 290 existing P23 slots.
